title: Christmas in Victoria and the Butchart Gardens
includes: 1 Bottle of water for each passenger
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Infant seats are available on request if advised at time of booking (1 only)
Handicapped accessible depending on the level of ability of the guest,please inquire within
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Enjoy the beautiful atmosphere of Christmas in Victoria and the Butchart Gardens. Start the evening by heading straight to the Butchart Gardens to avoid the crowds and enjoy their incredible light display and festive atmosphere. After Butchart Gardens, stop by some of Victoria's top residential Christmas lights displays. At the end of the tour, your guide will take time to enjoy the festive lights of the Inner Harbor. The tour is approximately 4.5 hours from pick up to drop off.
